summary: Iteration 106 - Rate Parity & Competitor Analysis Testing Complete. All 13 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI fully functional with Rate Parity tab showing parity scan, KPI cards (Parity Score, In Parity, Minor Issues, Violations, Dates Checked), channel legend (6 OTAs), and color-coded grid table. Competitor Analysis tab shows KPI cards (Our Avg Rate, Competitor Avg, Price Position, Action Items), detailed comparison table with 14 days, and Robot Intelligence Insights panel with prioritized recommendations.

tests: POST /api/revenue/market-robot/all/parity/scan scans 14 dates across 6 OTA channels
Returns violations_found count, dates_scanned, channels_checked
Stores parity data in rate_parity collection
GET /api/revenue/market-robot/all/parity returns parity_data array
Each entry has date, our_price, channels with price/diff_pct/status
Status values: parity (<=1%), minor (1-5%), violation (>5%)
Summary includes parity_score, in_parity, minor_issues, violations counts
GET /api/revenue/market-robot/all/competitor-analysis returns comparison array (14 days)
Each entry has our_price, comp_avg, comp_min, comp_max, diff_pct, position, demand_level
Position labels: Premium (>10%), Above Avg (0-10%), Competitive (-10-0%), Undercut (<-10%)
KPIs include our_avg_rate, competitor_avg_rate, position_label, events_tracked
Insights array with type (opportunity/warning/success/info), title, desc, action, priority
Rate Parity tab accessible via Market Robot > Rate Parity
Scan All Channels button triggers parity scan
5 KPI cards: Parity Score (91-99%), In Parity, Minor Issues, Violations, Dates Checked
Channel legend shows 6 OTAs with color badges
Grid table with color-coded cells (green=parity, amber=minor, red=violation)
Each cell shows OTA price and diff_pct with status icon
Competitor Analysis tab accessible via Market Robot > Competitor Analysis
4 KPI cards: Our Avg Rate, Competitor Avg, Price Position, Action Items
Detailed Price Comparison table with 14 days
Demand level column shows HIGH/MODERATE/LOW with percentage
Robot Intelligence Insights panel with prioritized findings
Insights show type badges (high/medium/low priority) and action recommendations
Market Robot now has 9 sub-tabs
Tabs: Dashboard, Supply Data, Rate Parity, Competitor Analysis, Event Intelligence, Competitor Hotels, Auto-Adjustments, Configuration, Scan Logs

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 106 tested the NEW Rate Parity and Competitor Analysis features. Competitor Analysis combines competitor data, market supply, and events to generate prioritized insights. Note: OTA prices are SIMULATED (real OTA APIs require partnership agreements). Navigation: Revenue > Market Robot > Rate Parity or Competitor Analysis tab.
